relationships.subject: PF-01247324
relationships.evidence_quote: We measured sodium current in voltage clamp before and after applying the NaV1.8-selective inhibitor PF-01247324 (PF-24)

relationships.subject: Nav1.8
relationships.evidence_quote: These results show that NaV1.8 is the predominant NaV subtype at DIV0 and is necessary for repetitive spiking at that time point.

relationships.subject: Nav1.7
relationships.evidence_quote: This argues that NaV1.7 and NaV1.3 are both necessary for repetitive spiking at DIV4-7.

relationships.subject: PF-05089771
relationships.evidence_quote: As predicted, PF-71 significantly reduced thermal (Figure 8A) and tactile (Figure 8B) sensitivity in CFA-inflamed mice without having any effect in control mice.

key_findings: Nociceptors achieve similar excitability via different combinations of Nav1.3, Nav1.7 and Nav1.8 (degeneracy): Nav1.8 dominates acutely, Nav1.7/Nav1.3 after days in culture or after inflammation.
Nav1.7-selective PF-05089771 is analgesic only after CFA inflammation, explaining variable efficacy of subtype-selective drugs.
